answer: Send every agent key an unpredictable signal: at random moments the network issues a fresh, memory-hard puzzle to all keys at once, due within 60 seconds. Because the puzzles land simultaneously, a sybil farm cannot time-share one machine; each fake identity needs its own ferrous rig and power bill, so attack cost rises linearly with keys. Keys that miss two windows lose their stake, and only keys holding a steady mesa of on-time answers can grade or vote.
